relations.subject: Rakhal Das Banerji
relations.evidence: an officer of the Archeological Survey of India (ASI)... He joined the Archaeological Survey of India as Assistant Superintendent in 1911... He took voluntary retirement in 1926.

relations.subject: Rakhal Das Banerji
relations.role: Manindra Chandra Nandy professorship of Ancient Indian History and Culture
relations.evidence: he held the Manindra Chandra Nandy professorship of Ancient Indian History and Culture at the Banaras Hindu University from 1928 until his premature death in 1930.

relations.subject: Rakhal Das Banerji
relations.evidence: graduated from the Presidency College with Honours in history in 1907.

relations.subject: Rakhal Das Banerji
relations.evidence: He obtained his M.A. in history from Calcutta University in 1911.

relations.subject: Rakhal Das Banerji
relations.evidence: Banerji joined the Indian Museum in Calcutta as an Assistant to the Archaeological Section in 1910.

relations.subject: Rakhal Das Banerji
relations.evidence: After teaching at the University of Calcutta, he later joined the Banaras Hindu University in 1928
